title: Build Iberia Essentials
description: The official Build Iberia essentials modpack. A curated selection of mods for our builder's team.
body:
# Official Build Iberia Essentials Modpack
Welcome to the **Build Iberia Essentials Modpack**, the definitive modpack curated for the ambitious project of recreating the Iberian Peninsula (Spain, Portugal, and Andorra) in Minecraft. This pack is meticulously balanced to provide builders with technical precision, high-end aesthetics, and rock-solid performance.

## 🚀 Key Features

* **Powerful Optimization:** Powered by Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore and Better Block Entities to ensure smooth performance all across the server while using Iris mod and any shaders pack.

* **Quality Tools:** Includes the latest versions of *WorldEdit* and *Axiom* tools, bringing new ways to build better and faster.
  
* **Seamless Connectivity:** Optimized for our official servers, allowing you to join the project with a single click.

* **Personalized Launcher:** Personalized menus and UI elements to bring a more fresh and fun look to the Minecraft Launcher.




## 📦 Included Mods

This pack runs on the **Fabric** loader and features:
1.  **Performance and Visuals:** Sodium, Sodium Extra, Lithium, FerriteCore, Better Block Entities, EntityCulling and Iris.
   
2.  **Building Tools:** WorldEdit, WorldEdit (CUI) and Axiom.
   
3.  **UI/Life Quality:** Voxy, Cubes Without Borders, ModMenu, FancyMenu and Resourcefy.
   



## ⛓️‍💥 Having Trouble?

If you are having problems installing the modpack or encounter any bugs or glitches, let us know in the #support channel in our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/yrqJXf2rub).




## ❇️ Updating the modpack

The modpack will receive future updates as bugs are fixed and new features are implemented, apart from updating to future Minecraft versions. To make it easier for you, we recommend installing, playing and updating the modpack through Prism Launcher.
